Class MathArrowNode

java.lang.Object
com.vladsch.flexmark.util.ast.Node
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.render.flexmark.MathArrowNode
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.vladsch.flexmark.util.ast.DoNotDecorate
public class MathArrowNode extends com.vladsch.flexmark.util.ast.Node implements com.vladsch.flexmark.util.ast.DoNotDecorate
AST node representing an inlined mathematical symbol or directional arrow.

This node stores the underlying Unicode representation of the symbol while preserving the original markdown source coordinates. It implements DoNotDecorate to prevent subsequent AST post-processors from modifying its contents.
